messages:
emma: Heads up 1: Customer CloudLens reported a $6.7k unexpected burst on their Dedicated commit for May (INV-5022). They insist our vendor-side metering double-counted some GPU-hours. Ticket SUP-9442 attached.
ravi-fin: Can you paste the invoice lines?
emma: INV-5022 snippet:
``nINV-5022
- Reserved commit (May): $9,000
- Burst overage (05/12 02:15-02:50 UTC): $6,700
Total due: $15,700
```
olga-cs: Customer says their monitoring shows only ~42 GPU-hours extra, but our invoice implies ~156 GPU-hours. They're asking for an immediate audit and provisional credit.
metering-bot: Metering extract request submitted to vendor gateway at 2026-05-13T09:02Z. Pending vendor response. (ref: MGW-REQ-559)
vendor-ops: Confirming received MGW-REQ-559. We will reconcile meter logs across both sides and return raw event dump by EOD.
ravi-fin: If vendor mis-attributed duplicate events we need to reverse-bill and issue credit. Meanwhile we should hold collection on INV-5022.
emma: Agreed. Can finance issue a provisional credit while vendor audit proceeds? The AE wants to calm the customer.
ravi-fin: We can issue a provisional hold and a provisional credit memo up to 80% of the disputed amount if the evidence suggests vendor error. But need a simple two-line approval from ops + cs. @vendor-ops, any early signs?
vendor-ops: Initial check: looks like a replication bug in the vendor gateway retried metric publishes during a transient 2xx->5xx flapping window. Likely duplicated meter events. We estimate ~110 duplicate GPU-hours. Sending detailed dump in 45m.
olga-cs: Customer wants language: "we will investigate and provisionally credit while we reconcile". We should keep wording conservative.
ravi-fin: Proposed approach: 1) Place INV-5022 on collection hold. 2) Create provisional credit CN-5022-PROV for $5,360 (80% of $6,700). 3) Run full vendor reconciliation; final credit amount to be adjusted after audit. Approve?
emma: CS approves provisional credit and hold if vendor audit confirms duplication. We'll tell CloudLens we'll refund or adjust within 5 business days.
vendor-ops: Acknowledged. We'll expedite log export and add trace ids. ETA 4h.
billing-bot: Action: place collection hold on INV-5022; create provisional credit CN-5022-PROV $5,360. Note: tag=vendor-duplication-provisional.
ravi-fin: Please also create FIN ticket FIN-1011: "Vendor meter duplication - reconciliations + recoveries" and assign to vendor partnerships + billing.
olga-cs: Sending message to CloudLens: "We placed a provisional credit and hold while we reconcile vendor metering; will follow up with final numbers within 5 business days."
emma: Customer replied: thanks, please confirm when CN posts and if any refund is required.
vendor-ops: Log dump uploaded to secure bucket. Early reconciliation shows 112 duplicate GPU-hours; recommended final credit = $4,800.
ravi-fin: If vendor confirms 112 duplicate hours => credit $4,800. We created provisional for $5,360, so final adjustment will be a debit of $560 back to AR (reduce provisional). Approve final CN-5022-1 for $4,800 and close provisional?
em: (typo) ravi-fin: Approve pending one more ops signoff.
vendor-ops: Ops confirms reconciliation match to vendor-side metrics. Duplicate events = 112 GPU-hours.
olga-cs: Customer notified and satisfied with reconciliation. They asked for a short blurb on remediation so they can close internal ticket.
ravi-fin: Final steps: 1) Post CN-5022-1 $4,800 (reason=vendor-duplicate-metering). 2) Reverse provisional CN-5022-PROV and post net adjustment of -$560. 3) Process refund if payment already captured. 4) Close collection hold.
billing-bot: Posting CN-5022-1 $4,800 and reversing CN-5022-PROV (net $-560 adjustment). Collection hold cleared. Refund queued if payment captured. (refund ETA 2 business days)
emma: Thanks 1: I'll update CloudLens and the AE. Also copying vendor partnership.
ravi-fin: Note for retrospective: consider SLA clause for vendor-metering failures and add a monitoring alarm for duplicated meter publishes. Filing FIN-1012.
olga-cs: Closing thread 1: customer happy, CN posted.
